topic: University students protested over unpaid Education Loan Fund scholarships and joined a fuel-shortage and rising-prices demonstration in Ulaanbaatar
scale: Hundreds at Sukhbaatar Square on 2026-10-01 per news.mn and Asia Daily; the student scholarship protest reported as a separate Ulaanbaatar protest the same Thursday, no headcount given

quote2: The other involved university students protesting after their Education Loan Fund scholarships were not paid due to a lack of budget.
